amountPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
choosePeople: Choose who paid and who received the payment.
differentPeople: The payer and recipient must be different people.
validDate: Enter a valid date as YYYY-MM-DD.
needBalances: Authoritative balances are needed to review this payment.
directionWarning: This payment does not match the current debt direction. Review the resulting balances.
creditWarning: The amount beyond the current payable balance is {{amount}} and becomes credit.
confirmation: {{from}} paid {{to}} {{amount}} outside Tally Stick on {{date}} (UTC). {{effect}} Tally Stick records it; it does not move money.
warningConfirmation: {{from}} paid {{to}} {{amount}} outside Tally Stick on {{date}} (UTC). {{warning}} {{effect}} Tally Stick records it; it does not move money.
whichBalance: Which balance do you want to settle?
suggestedHint: Based on Simplify debts. Tally Stick tracks each member's total in this group, not who owes whom. Nothing is recorded until you confirm.
unbalanced: Group balances do not add up to zero.
restored: Restored your saved payment draft. Review the people and amount.
revision: Saving creates a replacement revision; history is kept.
twoMembers: An external payment needs two active members.
externalOnly: Record money already paid or received elsewhere. Tally Stick does not move money.
openLedger: Open Record payment from an active group or friend ledger.
discardDraftBody: This removes the saved payment details from this device.
recordedOnly: Recorded only. This payment happened outside Tally Stick.
deletedBody: This record remains in Tally Stick’s audit history and no longer affects balances.
deleteBody: Delete the payment from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{amount}})? This reverses its balance effect. It does not reverse any money paid outside Tally Stick.
deleteLedgerBody: Delete the payment from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{amount}}) in {{ledger}}? This reverses its balance effect. It does not reverse any money paid outside Tally Stick.
conflict: Keep your edits, or load the latest revision. Loading replaces the values in this form.
discardBody: Your changes have not been saved. The recorded history stays unchanged.
onlyRecorder: Only the person who recorded an active payment can edit it.
